Name: Storage Variety for FSF
Author: Eimakore
Description:
[b][size=5]Storage Variety for FSF[/size][/b]
Storage Variety for FSF adds six distinct and fully functional storage containers to Stardew Valley using artwork created by [b]6480[/b].
Each container has its own capacity, inventory layout, acquisition method, appearance, and optional specialization. The pack showcases features such as animations, player-selected colors, item filters, crafting recipes, shop acquisition, scrolling inventories, and multi-tile footprints.
[b]Flexible Storage Framework 1.0.0 or newer is required. This pack does not work without FSF.[/b]

[b][size=4]Included Storage Containers[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Ice Cooler[/b]
[list]
[*]24 slots arranged as 12×2[/*]
[*]Accepts fish only[/*]
[*]Crafting recipe unlocked at Fishing level 2[/*]
[*]Animated and colorable[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Cigar Box[/b]
[list]
[*]12 slots arranged as 12×1[/*]
[*]Accepts all items[/*]
[*]Crafting recipe sold by Robin for 1,000g[/*]
[*]Animated and colorable[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Wooden Cabinet[/b]
[list]
[*]60 slots arranged as 12×5[/*]
[*]Accepts clothing, hats, and boots only[/*]
[*]Crafting recipe sold by Robin for 2,000g[/*]
[*]Animated and colorable[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Lumber Pile[/b]
[list]
[*]42 slots arranged as 14×3[/*]
[*]Accepts building resources only[/*]
[*]Crafting recipe unlocked at Foraging level 1[/*]
[*]Static appearance without recoloring[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Mini Storage Shed[/b]
[list]
[*]126 slots arranged as 14×9[/*]
[*]Accepts all items[/*]
[*]Crafting recipe sold by Robin for 5,000g[/*]
[*]Uses a 2×1 tile footprint[/*]
[*]Animated and colorable[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Wrought-Iron Cellar[/b]
[list]
[*]140 slots arranged as 14×10[/*]
[*]Accepts all items[/*]
[*]Crafting recipe sold by Robin for 5,000g[/*]
[*]Uses a 2×2 tile footprint[/*]
[*]Animated and colorable[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Large Storage Menus[/size][/b]
The Mini Storage Shed and Wrought-Iron Cellar retain their full capacities.
FSF displays up to six inventory rows at once, with the remaining rows accessible by scrolling. No storage slots are lost because of the visible-row limit.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Flexible Storage Framework 1.0.0 or newer[/*]
[/list]Content Patcher is not required.

[b][size=4]Optional Integrations[/size][/b]
Through Flexible Storage Framework, the containers are compatible with:
[list]
[*]Automate[/*]
[*]Better Crafting[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Flexible Storage Framework 1.0.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Download Storage Variety for FSF.[/*]
[*]Extract the entire pack folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Your folder structure should look similar to this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    ├── FlexibleStorageFramework/
    └── Storage Variety for FSF/[/code][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with vanilla crafting.[/*]
[*]Compatible with Better Crafting.[/*]
[*]Supports Automate, including connections around multi-tile footprints.[/*]
[*]Item filters prevent Automate from inserting disallowed items.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer compatibility has not yet been fully tested.[/*]
[*]FSF carry mode is host-only. Farmhands cannot lift storage containers, and host carry behavior in multiplayer has not yet been verified.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Updating[/size][/b]
Delete the previous version of the pack and install the new version.
Do not change the pack’s storage IDs. Existing placed containers use these IDs to preserve their identities, contents, capacities, and behavior.

[b][size=4]Uninstallation[/size][/b]
For maximum safety, empty and remove the custom containers before permanently uninstalling the pack.
If the pack is removed while Flexible Storage Framework remains installed, its placed containers fall back to functional vanilla chests instead of disappearing. Their contents and identifying metadata remain preserved. Reinstalling the pack restores their custom appearance and behavior.

[b][size=4]Credits and Permissions[/size][/b]
Storage artwork for the Ice Cooler, Cigar Box, Wooden Cabinet, Lumber Pile, Mini Storage Shed, and Wrought-Iron Cellar was created by [b]6480[/b] and comes from [b]6480’s Storage Variety[/b].
The artwork is used under the original author’s published asset-use permission. Please do not remove this credit when redistributing this pack or adapting these assets.

Original artwork:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7807]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7807[/url]

[b]Reporting Issues[/b]
When reporting a problem, please include:
[list]
[*]A link to your complete SMAPI log[/*]
[*]Your Flexible Storage Framework version[/*]
[*]Your Storage Variety for FSF version[/*]
[*]The affected storage container[/*]
[*]A description of what happened[/*]
[*]Whether the issue also occurs without other storage or inventory mods[/*]
[/list]Please do not paste only the red error text. The complete SMAPI log usually contains the information needed to identify the cause.
